newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.AFRICAN POPULATION SEEN GROWING AT 1.7 PCT.
newsitem.headline: S.AFRICAN POPULATION SEEN GROWING AT 1.7 PCT.

text.p: South Africa's population is estimated to grow 1.7 percent a year from 42.1 million now to 54.1 million in the year 2011, University of South Africa researchers said on Monday.
They said in a report that they based their estimates on the last national census in 1991 but acknowledged that reliable figures, especially for the number of illegal immigrants, were hard to obtain.
The report said there was unlikely to be any growth in the white population. Black population growth should slow with increasing economic development, it said.
A new national census is due to start next month.
